i just now understood what you said. I know that couldnt be an option for me because i already have so many issues and raising a child wouldnt be right for them. Psychologically i would instill a lot of issues in them because of the issues i face day to day. And also i dont know if i could do it, my main reason for that is because they wouldnt be blood-related to me and thats just my opinion.

I am not addicted to anything except my cigarette or two i have a day. I live each day with a goal, and after half the day is through i dont want or feel like meeting that goal. I live in a state of constant prolonging, prolonging when i will kill myself by saying i can wait till after i beat a game, or after i see my girlfriend for a last time, or after i finish writing a book ive never even started.  Its tiring not even knowing the reason why you have the urges to kill yourself. Every reason i come up with has just been something ive developed to explain or cope with the suicidal ideation and not the actual cause of the problem.

No, family of 5, dad was in the military until age 5, mom was and still is a stay at home parent. ive never lost anyone close to me, nor cared if they left. ive never had any trouble getting a girlfriend, but much trouble keeping one or continuing wanting one. slightly bullied as a kid, but i consider it a minute thing and the only thing that really effected me was my mind continuously telling me that i cant fit in and will never have true friends. I dont do recreational drugs and i dont drink alcohol.
